title: Positional audio + unused Soldat sounds (footsteps, ricochets, whizz-bys, distant gunfire, deaths, ambience)
body: Requested: more sound. Sfx now plays world sounds from AudioStreamPlayer2D at the event position (distance attenuation + panning); far gunfire / explosions switch to dist-gun*/dist-grenade/dist-m79. Wired footsteps, landings, ricochets, whizz-bys, death cries + headchop, grenade pin/bounce, weapon switch/pickup/throw, roll, prone, spawn, rain/snow loop. tools/sound_test.gd in gate stage F.

title: Team radio callouts (V) with Soldat radio voice lines
body: Soldat's radio: enemy flag carrier / friendly flag carrier / enemy spotted + up / mid / down. Team-only voice line + chat line, sender validated like team chat, rate-limited. Bots on the robbed team call out the enemy flag carrier. Number keys stay blocked for weapon switching until released. tools/radio_test.gd in gate stage F.

title: Medikits and grenade kits from the original map spawn points
body: The .pms spawn types 7 (grenade kit) and 8 (medikit) were dropped by the port. pms_to_map.py now exports them (settled on the ground) and all 99 bundled maps were re-merged from the .pms files (plus .pms weather where the JSON had none). Runtime reuses the host-authoritative bonus-box sync; kits heal / refill players and bots, only when useful, respawn after 25 s. Bots seek them when hurt / out of grenades. tools/kit_test.gd in gate stage F.

title: Barrett doesn't fire (spins up, no shot)
body: Reported in play: the Barrett has no shot coming out. Cause: semi-auto + startup 0.32 s; the semi-auto gate (lmb_prev) was true by the time spin_up_t reached startup, so can_fire was always false. Fix: a click arms one queued shot (_semi_armed) that fires after the wind-up; one round per click. tools/fire_test.gd in gate stage F fails on the old code.

title: Explain modes and items in game (labels, banners, tooltips)
body: Reported: no way to tell what power-ups do or what Generate + Play does; asked to label all items and explain modes. Added scripts/game_info.gd (single source of mode/item/weapon text), mode description + tooltips in menu and host pickers, match-start mode banner, full mode name in the top bar, goal in pause menu and H card, floating name tags over crates/kits/weapons/points/M2, pickup toasts, bonus countdown hint, tooltips on menu and editor buttons. tools/label_test.gd in gate stage F checks coverage and that win numbers match main.gd.

title: Bots spawn outside HH's building and slide off the map
body: Found in the full audit (DM sweep, map 53 HH: 9 falls in 30 s). _safe_spawn_near nudged a blocked spawn up to 440 px sideways, through the building wall onto the steep outer face. Fix: _spawn_slide_ok() requires no terrain between original and nudged spawn (ray) and standable ground (<120 px drop, not a cliff face).

title: Bots walk off ledges into the void with a full jet tank
body: Audit: Airpirates / Jungle bots fell with 100 fuel (idle walking off ledge, or diving after a target). Added a void rescue in bot.gd: falling with nothing but the kill line below -> jet + steer back toward the last safe floor x. All-maps DM sweep: falls 50 -> 9, kills +10%. Airpirates still has a few falls under the tree overhang.

title: Fast bullets tunnel through soldiers (Barrett never hits for bots)
body: Audit weapon test: a bot with the Barrett fired 5+ shots at a standing player without a hit. Barrett moves 40 px/frame vs a ~14 px hitbox and bullet.gd only used overlap. Fix: swept ray from old to new position each physics step; same-team bodies are excluded after a pass-through.

title: Bot M79 fires a straight bullet instead of a lobbed grenade
body: WEAPON_STATS had M79 as kind bullet: a 470 px/s 90-dmg straight shot with no blast. Now kind launcher with gravity 980 using rocket.gd ballistic mode; bots compute a low-arc launch angle (_lob_aim) and hold fire when the target is out of reach.

title: LAW/M79 bots stand idle at close range
body: Audit: a LAW bot that closed within ROCKET_MIN_RANGE never fired again (just stood next to the enemy). Now it swaps to the USSOCOM up close and back to the launcher beyond 1.6x the minimum range.

title: Engine errors: 'flushing queries' on grenade spawn, 'Lambda capture was freed'
body: Logs from gate run 23 showed 32 'Can't change this state while flushing queries' (grenade.gd _ready add_child during a physics callback) and 27 'Lambda capture ... was freed' (bot radio timer, peer despawn husk timer, smoke-die watcher). Shape add is deferred; timers capture instance ids / bound methods. The gate's error regex now includes both messages.

title: Sky / horizon gradient shows horizontal banding lines
body: Screenshot audit at 1920x1080: faint horizontal lines across the sky. sky.gd and parallax.gd drew gradients as stacked rects overlapping by 1 px (translucent ones doubled alpha on seams). Replaced with vertex-coloured polygons.

title: Audit tooling: weapon range test, sweep death counter
body: New tools/weapon_test.gd (gate F): every player weapon hits/uses ammo/reloads; every bot weapon hurts a player. stuck_test autopilot death counter fixed (SP respawn reuses the body).
